items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: All King Oliver ever did was to record Froggy Moore Blues once.

ctx.x: That was some a year ago. See, he was playing with T-Garden's band.

Yes, well I have a recording that he made of Froggy Moore, and they called it Froggy Moore Blues. I don't know, I'm not sweating about that yet. They called it Froggy Moore Blues, and on the outside of the cover, it says this tune, the King Oliver tune, Froggy Moore's blues, so and so and so, went on like that. All King Oliver ever did was to record Froggy Moore Blues once.

items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1964-11-28
items.q: it was in honor of Joe Oliver, I think.

ctx.x: Well, you know, that's a beautiful thing, though. Oh, it is. Original Rags, it's very nice. One of the nicest things, I like that Mr. Joe, where do you ever get the Mr. Joe tune, you know? Whose was that?
Well, it's Mr. Joe, it was, it was in honor of Joe Oliver, I think.

items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1958-Fall
items.q: I think King Oliver played in there. I'm very sure he did... I walked the full length of the dance hall... King Oliver, I'm sure, was standing up in front there... I said, what's the name of that tune you just played? And he said, that's Chicken Reel... I never concerned myself as who was playing.

ctx.x: Did you get in, when you were in New Orleans, did you get into any of those dance halls down there? Well, I used to look in on them.

I never, I kind of went out to be strolling around, of course they were playing good jazz there in those places. They were pretty rough places, weren't they? Well, they were, they were, well, there was a pretty heavy crowd, you may say, the roughnecks that did that. But I don't recall any disturbance except when they killed Billy Phillips. And that was rough that night. That's Billy Phillips. Yeah, he ran the 101 Ranch. The competition was right across the street at the tuxedo competition. And the story was then,…
Plus the musicians all remember who played, but nobody else does down there from that period, I guess.
